description: Fictional student workspace. Relevant keys were labelled by reading the records; unknown questions have no supporting source. This is a small regression set, not a production accuracy estimate.

data.title: Systems laboratory
data.description: Bring safety goggles and a lab notebook. Complete the pre-lab checklist before arriving.

data.title: Negative feedback
data.text: Negative feedback reduces a deviation from a target. A thermostat senses the room temperature, compares it with the set point, and switches heating to reduce the difference.

data.title: Restoring my workspace
data.text: Before an upgrade I save a complete workspace backup from Settings. To recover after a bad upgrade, I stop LifeOS, restore the saved database and file bytes, then check a note and a recording before continuing.

data.title: Thin film spin coating
data.text: Spin coating spreads a liquid film by rotating a substrate. Film thickness depends on spin speed, solution viscosity and evaporation. Our fictional sample recipe calls for 30 seconds at 3000 rpm after dispensing the solution.

data.title: Planter prototype review
data.description: Meet the design group to review the water reservoir sketch. Bring the cardboard prototype and the measured container dimensions.

data.title: Lentil soup recipe
data.text: Simmer red lentils, carrots and chopped tomato in vegetable stock for 20 minutes. Season to taste and serve with bread. Freeze leftover portions in labelled containers.

data.title: Measurement uncertainty
data.text: Repeated measurements help estimate random uncertainty. A consistent offset suggests systematic error; taking more readings does not remove it. Compare the instrument with a known reference before adjusting its calibration.

data.title: Running recovery plan
data.text: After a long training run I schedule an easy recovery day instead of speed work. My saved plan leaves Monday for rest and Wednesday for a short easy run. This is a personal planning example, not medical advice.

data.title: Library book return
data.description: Return the borrowed materials textbook at the campus library service desk. Renew it online first if I still need it.

data.title: Diffusion and concentration gradients
data.text: Diffusion is the net movement of particles from a region of higher concentration toward lower concentration. A steeper concentration gradient increases the flux in Fick's first law. Heating generally increases the diffusion coefficient.
